subject: only enforce inlining of XXH64_finalize() when XXH_INLINE_ALL is enabled
perf_evidence: Commit changes forced inlining of the XXH64 finalizer to the inline-all build mode, reducing default implementation code size.
change_summary: Makes XXH64_finalize static by default and force-inline only under XXH_INLINE_ALL.

units.name: public XXH64 one-shot and streaming fixed-length matrix across implementation/inline-all modes
units.evidence: Nine fixed-length one-shot/streaming targets pass both directions in default implementation mode; the inline-all and no-hints variants separately pass the same matrix.

units.name: public XXH64 one-shot with symbolic length, implementation mode
units.evidence: The symbolic-length XXH64 target passes bidirectional Alive2 with loop unroll 4.

notes: Symbolic-length proof is loop bounded; compiler/build combinations beyond the checked Clang configurations are not covered.
